description: This file defines the internal class SiloOptionsLogger, which extends OptionsLogger and implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in the Orleans silo lifecycle, primarily for logging silo options during startup.

classes.name: SiloOptionsLogger
classes.description: An internal class responsible for logging silo options during the Orleans silo startup lifecycle, extending OptionsLogger and participating in silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers the SiloOptionsLogger to be called during the First stage of the silo lifecycle, to perform actions at startup.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Executes the logging of options when the silo startup begins, returning a completed task.
